data.text:
Shabna S vs Reshma M.K. Food Safety Officer ... on 25 June, 
2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Crl.MC No.2422/2022 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas
 Tuesday, the 25th day of June 2024 / 4th Ashadha, 1946
 Crl.M.Appl.No.1/2022 In Crl.Mc No. 2422 Of 2022
 Cc 1257/2020 Of Court Of Judicial Magistrate Of First Class - I, Kalpetta,
 Wayanad
 Petitioners/Petitioners:
 1. Shabna S, Aged 33 Years, W/O Amay Lal, Koffi(H), Ambilerie,
 Kalpetta P.O. Wayanad 673 121 Mob 8086644524 (Food Business Operator
 And Licensee Of The Shop Which Sold Unsafe Kashmiri Chilli Powder To
 The Food Safety Officer) , Pin - 673121. And 3 Others. 
 Respondents/Respondents:
 1. Reshma M.K. Food Safety Officer Kalpetta Circle Kalpetta P.O.
 Wayanad 673121 Kalpetta P.O. Wayanad 673121 . And 2 Others. 
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the  High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in C.C. 1257/2020  pending on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate, Kalpetta  pending disposal of the above Criminal Misscellaneous case. 
 This Application again coming on for orders upon perusing the  application and this Court's order dated 25/03/2024 in Crl.M.A.1/2022 and  upon hearing the arguments of Mr. PREMJIT NAGENDRAN, Advocate for  petitioners and of Mr. SANTHAN V.NAIR, Advocate for R3 and the Public  Prosecutor for R1 and R2, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Interim order shall stand extended by six months.
Sd/- BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE 25-06-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Shabna S vs Reshma M.K. Food Safety Officer ... on 25 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50098151/
